Liiga player game log

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_player_game_log.Rd

One player's game log for a season, every tournament.

Usage

liiga_player_game_log(player_id, season)

Arguments

player_id

Player id (player_id in liiga_players_info or a lineup; equals fihaId), e.g. 21870028.

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025-26).

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (42 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerPlayer id; the same number in lineups, rosters, stat tables and the profile (fihaId).
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26).
tournamentcharacterTournament of the game (the body's list key): regular, playoffs, practice, qualifications, playout, chl or pitsiturnaus.
game_strcharacterMatchup label, e.g. HPK - LUK.
game_idintegerGame id, unique only within a season: key a game as (season, game_id).
datecharacterGame start, ISO 8601 UTC.
assistsintegerAssists (player, this game).
blocked_or_saved_shotsintegerBlocked or saved shots (player, this game).
faceoffs_totalintegerFaceoffs total (player, this game).
faceoffs_wonintegerFaceoffs won (player, this game).
faceoffs_percentagenumericFaceoffs percentage (player, this game). Percent, 0-100, sent as a STRING.
goalsintegerGoals (player, this game).
minusintegerOn ice for goals against (the - of plus/minus).
total_pointsintegerTotal points (player, this game).
home_team_namecharacterDisplay name of the home team of the game, e.g. HPK.
away_team_namecharacterDisplay name of the away team of the game, e.g. Lukko.
penalty_minutesintegerPenalty minutes (player, this game).
penaltykill_assistsintegerPenaltykill assists (player, this game).
penaltykill_goalsintegerPenaltykill goals (player, this game).
penaltykill_pointsintegerPenaltykill points (player, this game).
plusintegerOn ice for goals for (the + of plus/minus).
plus_minusintegerPlus/minus: on-ice goals for minus on-ice goals against.
powerplay_assistsintegerPowerplay assists (player, this game).
powerplay_goalsintegerPowerplay goals (player, this game).
powerplay_secondsintegerPowerplay seconds (player, this game). Seconds.
time_on_iceintegerTime on ice (player, this game). Seconds.
savesintegerSaves (player, this game).
save_percentagenumericSave percentage (player, this game). Percent, 0-100, sent as a STRING.
block_or_saved_shots_percentagenumericBlock or saved shots percentage (player, this game). Percent, 0-100, sent as a STRING.
shotsintegerShots (player, this game).
shots_into_goalintegerShots into goal (player, this game).
shut_outinteger1 for a goalkeeper's shutout in this game, else 0.
shots_savedintegerShots saved (player, this game).
shots_saved_by_skaterintegerShots saved by skater (player, this game).
shot_percentagenumericShot percentage (player, this game). Percent, 0-100, sent as a STRING.
shot_into_goal_percentagenumericShot into goal percentage (player, this game). Percent, 0-100, sent as a STRING.
goals_againstintegerGoals against (player, this game).
goalkeeperlogicalTrue when the player is a goalkeeper.
winning_goalsintegerWinning goals (player, this game).
woninteger1 when the player's team won the game, else 0.
tiedinteger1 when Liiga counts the game as a tie for the player's team, else 0 (overtime handling unverified).
lostinteger1 when the player's team lost the game, else 0.

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/players/info/{player_id}/games/{season}

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

See also

Other Liiga Functions: liiga_game(), liiga_game_goals(), liiga_game_lineups(), liiga_game_penalties(), liiga_game_players_stats(), liiga_game_shootout(), liiga_game_stats(), liiga_game_team_stats(), liiga_games(), liiga_gameweeks(), liiga_goals(), liiga_player(), liiga_player_career(), liiga_player_stats(), liiga_players_info(), liiga_schedule(), liiga_shotmap(), liiga_standings(), liiga_team_stats(), liiga_teams(), liiga_teams_history(), liiga_tournament()
